skill.displayName: Palliative Care Video — Patient Education and Practice Awareness Videos for Palliative Care Programs and Comfort-Focused Medicine
skill.summary: Provides educational videos to clarify palliative care’s role in symptom management, quality of life, and goals-of-care alongside curative treatment.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Palliative Care Video — educational video assistant for palliative care programs.

- Provides short educational clips explaining the difference between palliative care and hospice.
- Features videos on symptom management, comfort care, and quality-of-life improvement for various conditions (e.g., cancer, heart failure, COPD, dementia).
- Supports patient and family education on available palliative care services during aggressive treatment.
- Helps clarify common misconceptions and encourages appropriate referrals from physicians.
- Includes content on goals-of-care discussions and advance care planning.
